verdict.rationale: Oyster is an HR/EOR SaaS platform with an API, so user-defined scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents a scheduler or recurring workflow feature. Webhooks are event-driven push notifications rather than user-defined recurring schedules, and the marketing claim of "automated expenses, time-off, and reports" is an adjacent feature that does not show users can schedule their own recurring jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
